purpose: An active outer shares a detached middle's cached row. A copied current row mutates independently, null-key unpack leaves the real return23 continuation intact, and later next reaches yield13 and normal outer return29.
source:
<?php
class ReviewNestedDetachedFirst16 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewNestedDetachedSecond16 { function __destruct() { echo "B|"; } }
function reviewNestedDetachedLeaf16() { echo "C|"; yield [new ReviewNestedDetachedFirst16()]; echo "L|"; return 23; }
function reviewNestedDetachedMiddle16() { try { echo "H|"; $result = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "R|", $result, "|"; yield 13; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewNestedDetachedOuter16() { try { echo "G|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "O|"; return 29; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewNestedDetachedTarget16($value) { echo "BAD|"; }
$child = reviewNestedDetachedLeaf16(); $middle = reviewNestedDetachedMiddle16(); $outer = reviewNestedDetachedOuter16();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next();
$row = $outer->current(); $row[0] = new ReviewNestedDetachedSecond16();
echo "V|", $middle->current()[0] instanceof ReviewNestedDetachedFirst16 ? "HELD|" : "BAD|";
unset($child, $row); echo "M|";
try { reviewNestedDetachedTarget16(...$outer); }
catch (Error $error) { echo "T|", $error->getMessage() === "Keys must be of type int|string during argument unpacking" ? "KEY|" : "BAD|", $error->getTrace() === [] ? "NOFRAME|" : "BAD|"; }
echo "N|"; $outer->next(); echo "D|", $outer->current(), "|";
$outer->next(); echo "Q|", $outer->getReturn(), "|";
unset($outer, $middle); echo "E";

purpose: A middle initialized directly before temporary outer acquisition is detached and loses its independent CV through a helper. Null-key failure runs its own finally before cache destruction and outer finally, contrasting a middle initialized only through an outer link.
